defect.symptom: The physical chunk references capability and provenance sidecar hashes, but generic OpenBench uploads only one OUT file.
defect.false_inference_prevented: Uploading the physical chunk alone preserves complete resolvable provenance.
defect.cause: The P11 design had not joined G9's three-file transaction to OpenBench's single-file transport boundary.

additional_positive_matrix: exact bundle framing and section order
nested capability and provenance hashes equal the physical header
exclusive partial, fsync, reread and no-replace publish
OpenBench-shaped compression consumes the exact validated bundle
additional_negative_matrix: physical chunk uploaded without resolvable sidecars
section reorder, truncation, append or length overflow
capability, provenance, physical chunk, payload or schema digest mismatch
preexisting final overwritten or killed partial silently deleted
unchanged: OpenBench and production authorization remain false
stopping_rule: No local self-play PASS is possible unless an independent implementation resolves and authenticates all three bundle sections and the OpenBench-shaped path compresses exactly those validated bytes. Any orphan hash or opaque-only acceptance keeps the gate open.
claim_boundary: This addendum repairs transport completeness only. It does not close G11, authorize OpenBench, admit training data, establish strength or support release.
